id.summary: Lulusan S1 Teknik Informatika yang berfokus pada pengembangan Frontend Web dengan ekosistem React dan Next.js. Terbiasa membangun antarmuka yang responsif, mengelola client state (Zustand), melakukan integrasi API & server state (TanStack Query, Axios), validasi form (Zod), serta menerapkan autentikasi pengguna (NextAuth, RBAC). Memiliki profil kompetensi T-shaped dengan pemahaman adaptif terhadap lapisan pendukung full-stack (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM), kemauan belajar yang tinggi, serta kesiapan berkontribusi dalam tim pengembang.

achievements: Mengembangkan portal web sekolah menggunakan Next.js (App Router) dan Tailwind CSS dengan fitur CMS untuk mengelola berita, pengumuman, galeri kegiatan, serta direktori guru/staf.
Menambahkan fitur Bank Sampah sekolah untuk membantu pencatatan setoran siswa secara bertahap dan mencetak rekap laporan bulanan dalam format PDF secara otomatis.
Menerapkan autentikasi dan hak akses (RBAC) serta menghubungkan tampilan frontend publik dengan sistem pengelolaan data internal sekolah melalui API dan data fetching terstruktur.
Menjalankan proses deployment dan optimasi halaman menggunakan fitur static & dynamic rendering Next.js sehingga website lebih cepat diakses dan mudah ditemukan di mesin pencari.

projects.title: Platform Penjualan Otomotif
projects.description: Membangun aplikasi web katalog mobil dan pemesanan yang menghubungkan halaman pelanggan dengan dasbor admin. Mengelola state UI dan filter menggunakan Zustand, melakukan fetching serta caching data API dengan TanStack Query, dan menerapkan validasi form pemesanan dengan Zod. Dilengkapi fitur pembagian antrean pesan pelanggan (leads) otomatis ke agen sales yang aktif serta integrasi pengalihan chat langsung ke WhatsApp.

projects.title: Skripsi Prediksi Lintasan Siklon Tropis
projects.description: Membangun sistem prediksi dan visualisasi jalur siklon tropis berbasis LSTM serta mengevaluasi 12 skenario eksperimen (error Haversine rata-rata 14,2 km dan R² 0,999). Mengonversi model terbaik ke format ONNX untuk dijalankan langsung di browser menggunakan ONNX Runtime dan menampilkannya pada peta interaktif berbasis Astro Island Architecture.

projects.title: Website Penjualan Rumah
projects.description: Membangun antarmuka katalog properti dan tampilan denah kavling perumahan 2D yang responsif menggunakan arsitektur komponen Angular serta Tailwind CSS. Mengimplementasikan fitur filter pencarian properti dan kalkulator simulasi cicilan KPR dengan pengelolaan state reaktif (Signals & Data Binding).

skills.items: React, Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG, ISR), TypeScript, JavaScript, Zustand, TanStack Query (React Query), Zod, Data Fetching (Axios, REST API), NextAuth, Autentikasi RBAC & JWT, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Angular Dasar (RxJS)
PostgreSQL & MySQL, Prisma ORM, SQL, Git/GitHub, ONNX Runtime, Microsoft365
Pemecahan masalah, cepat belajar mandiri, komunikasi tim yang baik, teliti, dan disiplin

en.summary: Informatics Engineering graduate (B.S. in Computer Science) specializing in frontend web development within the React and Next.js ecosystem. Experienced in building responsive user interfaces, managing client-side state (Zustand), synchronizing server state and API integrations (TanStack Query, Axios), enforcing declarative form validation (Zod), and implementing role-based authentication (NextAuth, RBAC). Demonstrates a T-shaped engineering profile combining deep frontend proficiency with adaptive full-stack capabilities (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM) and collaborative discipline.

labels.modalSubtitle: Official Document Preview & Download Options (PDF / DOCX)

achievements: Developed the official school web portal using Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS, incorporating a content management system (CMS) to manage news, announcements, activity galleries, and staff directories.
Engineered a school Waste Bank (Bank Sampah) module to record incremental student deposits and automatically generate monthly summary reports in PDF format.

Implemented user authentication and role-based access control (RBAC), connecting the public-facing frontend interface with internal school data management through structured REST APIs and data fetching.
Executed deployment and page optimization utilizing Next.js static and dynamic rendering strategies, improving access speed and search engine discoverability.

projects.title: Automotive Commerce Platform (IngStore)
projects.description: Built a vehicle catalog and reservation web application connecting customer-facing storefront views with an administrative dashboard. Managed UI and multi-criteria filter state using Zustand, implemented API data fetching and caching via TanStack Query, and enforced reservation form validation with Zod. Developed an automated customer lead queue distribution mechanism to active sales agents with direct WhatsApp chat handoff.

projects.title: Tropical Cyclone Trajectory Forecasting System
projects.description: Developed an LSTM-based tropical cyclone trajectory prediction and visualization system, evaluating 12 experimental scenarios (achieving a mean Haversine error of 14.2 km and R² of 0.999). Converted the best-performing model into ONNX format for direct in-browser execution via ONNX Runtime and visualized trajectories on an interactive geospatial map powered by Astro Island Architecture.

projects.title: Residential Property Platform (HouseING)
projects.description: Constructed a responsive property catalog interface and an interactive 2D residential lot layout using Angular component architecture and Tailwind CSS. Implemented multi-parameter property search filtering and an annuity mortgage (KPR) installment simulation calculator backed by reactive state management (Signals & Data Binding).
